how_value_is_shown: Five numbered text reasons: double pumping, a bra for hands-free use, comfortable and pain-free, natural tongue-like movement, and increased milk production; each is spoken to camera and some are shown with the pump on her body while she moves around.
demonstration: She wears the pump inside a pink bra while walking and carrying a baby in the kitchen (6.8-10.4 s and 24.5-29 s); she holds up the pump parts and the tube (3-6 s, 14-24 s)
proof: Her own long-term use as stated (10 months of pumping, machine transcript), the pump visibly worn while she holds a baby; no measured result is shown
personal_story: Since giving birth she has pumped with Annabella (caption); 'מניקה ושואבת כבר עשרה חודשים, רק אנבלה' (machine transcript)
selling_language: 'משאבת החלב היחידה בעולם' (caption); 'חוויית שאיבה נעימה ללא כאב' (caption); 'סופר נוחה לשימוש' (machine transcript); 'רק אנבלה' (text, last frame)
captions_on_screen: burned-in short subtitles in white script at mid-frame, plus a large number and heading in the upper area for each of the five reasons
editing_rhythm: 8 detected shots in 29 s, 3.7 s average; each numbered reason on a new setup or crop; no speed changes verified
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: she stands with a baby on her hip and pump on, with the text 'רק אנבלה'. Caption: addressed to pregnant viewers, 'תוסיפי את משאבת אנבלה בלי לחשוב פעמיים'. No code or link; 68 comments per the 15 Oct count (likes hidden).
convincing: Interpretation: numbered structure with matching text, the product worn in real daily action with a baby, and a long-term-use credential make the claims easy to follow.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: the medical and performance claims (more milk, 'the only pump in the world' in the caption) are the brand's and are not demonstrated; the cuts between rooms make it feel staged; no price or code.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: numbered reasons as on-screen text with one setting change per reason is a clear structure; showing the product in use in daily life beats describing it. LumeBook can film a mother with a book at home in 5 short points (name in the story, her child's face, etc.) with large numbers at the top; keep claims about the product itself, not health.
solo_without_child: partly: the numbered talking-head parts can be filmed alone, but the baby adds the daily-life proof
not_verified: The exact medical claims are the creator's and the brand's; the machine transcript has errors (it renders the product category as 'משאבת העמקה'); whether the baby is the creator's; the number of likes (hidden); the audio background and music.
